issues: No numbers yet: there has been no run since the lint repair, so z cannot be computed and no claim can be checked.

No sign of getting around the measurement. No file or network access, no pasted answers. Test SMILES are only used as inputs. Test labels are never touched. choose_sigma2 is called on training data only.

The BRICS hash is deterministic: it is a position-weighted sum of character codes, not Python's salted hash(), so results can be repeated across processes. Collisions into 1024 bits are crude but harmless.
BRICSDecompose returns the molecule itself when nothing can be broken, so no fingerprint row is all zeros and the Tanimoto denominators cannot be zero.
The blend now gives the Morgan GP half of its old weight and the BRICS GP the other half. This is a real change in method, not a bug. The gain should be checked against the noise sd of about 0.007.
Minor style issue: the BRICS import sits apart from the other rdkit.Chem imports. BRICS decomposition adds per-molecule cost, but it should stay well within the 10-minute limit for 970 molecules.
